integrity_review.interpretation: Eight trial measurements compare the same original frozen snapshot. The end-of-suite active-pointer guard failed after a concurrent production release. Do not treat this as validation of the newly active native_qwen pipeline. Original suite status is retained.
integrity_review.timing_caution: The last baseline trial overlaps the concurrent production release. Its inputs/configuration remain comparable, but independent model warmup or other resource contention cannot be excluded. Keep all raw trials; do not use the larger second-round media41 speedup for the primary estimate.

configuration_change_review.change: Added a Qwen-only extractor configuration; existing OWL and face settings unchanged. Last child logs confirm only original OWL/face extractors and settings.
configuration_change_review.ingestion_change: replay.py does not import scripts/ingestion.py; it runs the originally implemented equivalent stages.
